inputs.text: France has a duty to defend public order and confront antisemitism, but that duty belongs under the law—not in the hands of unaccountable officials acting without proper limits. The rulings against MIVILUDES are a warning that bureaucratic power can erode religious freedom and public trust when transparency and due process are ignored. A nation’s secular tradition should uphold a common civic order, not give officials licence to intrude on the beliefs of Scientologists, Jehovah’s Witnesses, or any other citizens.
